samples.scenario: Passive Wi-Fi Eavesdropping Captures Unencrypted FTP Credentials on Open Hotel Network
samples.technical_data: [Complex structure with keys: wireshark_pcap_excerpt, ftp_login_sequence, wifi_signal_strength_log, network_interface_monitor_mode_config, captured_cleartext_passwords, tcp_stream_follow_command]
indicators: FTP login commands with USER and PASS in plaintext over port 21
Connection established to SSID 'HotelGuestWiFi' with no encryption
Wi-Fi interface operating in monitor mode capturing all packets
Repeated FTP authentication failures indicating brute force attempts

ARP spoofing and DNS spoofing to redirect traffic through attacker device
